notes: vCOW tokens vest linearly over 4 years from deployment for team, advisors, investors, and GnosisDAO.
Solver rewards and LP incentives are tracked on-chain as transfers from the DAO treasury to known incentive addresses.
A large portion of the tokens are still held by the DAO Treasury, these tokens are released based on governance proposals
